title: Create, roll and revoke API keys
caption: PF-30. Owners and admins of an active OTA.

steps.title: Open API keys
steps.body: The Test keys tab lists the two keys of the set-up ("at set-up").
steps.expect: Each key as `prefix…last4`, last used (up to 5 min behind) or Never; no full key anywhere.

steps.title: Create a secret key
steps.body: Name "Storefront prod", kind Secret, use Storefront, **Create the key**.
steps.expect: "Your new secret test key" with "Copy this now: it is shown only once"; `platform.api_keys` gains a row with `key_hash`, `scopes = {storefront}`; audit `api_key.created`.

steps.title: Publishable key with origins
steps.expect: Accepted on a test key; a path, wildcard, upper case or trailing slash is refused at its row; **Add an origin** is disabled once 20 origins are listed.

steps.title: Console automation key
steps.body: Use Console automation and tick at least one permission.
steps.expect: `scopes = {console:automation, <permissions…>}`; no permission → refused without a call.

steps.title: Roll
steps.body: **Roll** a key, old key stops "in 24 hours".
steps.expect: New key shown once; old row `expires_at` ≈ now + 24 h; audit `api_key.rolled`.

steps.title: Revoke
steps.expect: Row says "The key is revoked."; `revoked_at`, `revoked_by_account_id` set; the OTA API refuses the key within 60 s.
